message.content: Fusion nuclear research has produced tangible benefits for society beyond energy generation. Medical imaging technologies, such as magnetic resonance imaging, have roots in plasma physics techniques developed for fusion devices. Neutron sources from fusion experiments now support cancer treatment and materials analysis in hospitals. Superconducting magnets designed for tokamak confinement have improved transportation and industrial applications. The iritic of innovation from fusion programs has advanced computational modeling, benefiting weather forecasting and aerospace engineering. Fusion research has trained generations of scientists who now work across diverse industries, creating a skilled workforce that drives economic growth and progress in many fields.
